name: react-three-fiber
title: React Three Fiber
responsibility: Three.js as React components — declarative scenes, hooks, ecosystem (drei). The ONLY sanctioned way to use 3D inside React presets.
reachFor: WebGL experiences that would otherwise fight React's render model
avoid: 3D for its own sake — principle §9: use it when it creates a MEANINGFUL visual experience (product visualization, storytelling), not because it is possible
Full-page game-like scenes in a landing-page workspace
reactWiring: <Canvas> as the root; drei for controls/loaders; keep dpr clamped; frameloop='demand' for static scenes
